subject: executor: support left outer anti semi join for hash join v2 (#58479)
summary: Diff adds HashJoinV2 support for `logicalop.AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` by reusing the existing left-outer-semi probe with an `isAnti` flag (inverting the appended scalar result: match->0, no-match->1, null preserved), and updates planner gating (`PhysicalHashJoin.CanUseHashJoinV2`) to allow this join type when non-null-aware and otherwise already eligible. Checked executor probe selection/build-side constraints and null-handling parity with v1 joiner semantics; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found in the touched planner/executor paths.
